answer: When k bonded identities equivocate on the same conflicting claim, correlation links their evidence and triggers penalties proportional to k², not k independent minor fines. A sybil operator therefore risks an exponential multiplier in total capital loss upon detection as slashing compounds across escrows and asymmetric depreciation reduces recoverable value. Like a falcon shadowing a cedar-lined harbor, identities may appear separate, but shared behavior exposes the swarm.
